mechanism: Tenofovir is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially reducing amoxicillin-clavulanate clearance and increasing systemic exposure; concurrent use increases risk of acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal function deteriorates; dose adjust amoxicillin-clavulanate if creatinine clearance significantly declines.
